title: Building Products on Claude Opus 4.7 , A Customer Success Story with Solve Intelligence and Blitzy
description: Join founders and product leaders from Solve Intelligence and Blitzy , alongside a member of Anthropic's team , for an inside look at how two innovative companies are using Claude to power sophisticated AI experiences across two frontier domains: intellectual property and the full software development lifecycle.

segments.heading: Architectural Overview and System Objectives in Building Products on Claude Opus 4.7 , A Cust
segments.text: Join founders and product leaders from Solve Intelligence and Blitzy , alongside a member of Anthropic's team , for an inside look at how two innovative companies are using Claude to power sophisticated AI experiences across two frontier domains: intellectual property and the full software development lifecycle. The session details foundational design principles, execution patterns, and operational integration requirements within the AI Coding Tools, Web Development domain.

segments.heading: Technical Capabilities, Tooling Integration, and Protocols
segments.text: Speakers analyze technical capabilities across Anthropic, Claude, Claude Opus 4. The architecture highlights reliable agent tool use, context window optimization, protocol standards, and seamless workflow interoperability.

segments.heading: Production Deployment, Verification, and Best Practices
segments.text: Production readiness demands robust evaluation harnesses, state validation, and error-handling loops. Teams implement systematic monitoring and guardrails to ensure reliability across repeated executions.

segments.heading: Organizational Impact, Scalability, and Industry Outlook
segments.text: Deploying agentic systems transforms developer and team workflows by automating high-friction tasks. Organizations scale safely by pairing automated tool orchestration with structured human review.
